 How to see live election results for North Dakota and Minnesota
 Find live election results via the North Dakota and Minnesota Secretary of State offices.
 A voter casts a ballot on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026, at Memorial Auditorium at Concordia College in Moorhead. Chris Flynn / The Forum

 Results for North Dakota's and Minnesota's elections will posted to each state's Secretary of State website after polls close, as returns come in. Follow the links below to find results for each state.
 North Dakota election results 
 . Polls begin closing at 7 p.m. CT in North Dakota.
 Minnesota election results 
 . Polls close at 8 p.m. in Minnesota.
 Visit our Election Central page for coverage.

 Our newsroom occasionally reports stories under a byline of "staff." Often, the "staff" byline is used when rewriting basic news briefs that originate from official sources, such as a city press release about a road closure, and which require little or no reporting. At times, this byline is used when a news story includes numerous authors or when the story is formed by aggregating previously reported news from various sources. If outside sources are used, it is noted within the story.
